_note: One-line skill descriptions shared by the frontend (labels, cards) and the backend (chat context). Step text and timings live in frontend/src/content/skills.js.

skills.label: Paced breathing
skills.purpose: Breathe in for 4 seconds and out for 6, seven times, following a circle.

skills.label: STOP
skills.purpose: Pause, step back, notice, then choose what to do next, one short prompt at a time.

skills.label: Cognitive reframe
skills.purpose: Write down one thought, what supports it, and another way to see it. Typing is optional.
